card.name: Small words in general web prose
card.fires_on: No clear trigger. It fires on scattered small words such as a, the, to, by and on a stray piece of a number or abbreviation, in general web text about politics, energy and law.

modes.label: Article before a noun
modes.description: An article such as a or the sits right before an abstract noun phrase.
